reasons.SHORTAGE_RATE: Short on {{shortShifts}} of {{shifts}} shifts ({{percent}}%), against {{restPercent}}% for everyone else. 0.6 points for each percentage point above, up to 30.
reasons.SHORTAGE_AMOUNT: Shortages average {{perShift}} a shift, against {{restPerShift}} for everyone else. 1 point for each ₹25 above, up to 20.
reasons.SHORTAGE_TREND: {{earlier}} shortages in the first half of the period and {{recent}} in the second. 10 points when the second half has more, and at least 2.
reasons.CORRECTIONS: {{count}} voids, reassignments or rejections. {{expected}} per 30 days is normal; 8 points for each one more, up to 40.
reasons.NOT_ENOUGH_SHIFTS: Only {{shifts}} closed shifts in the period; shortages are scored from {{minimum}} shifts.
reasons.METER_AMENDMENTS: {{count}} meter amendments, {{lowering}} of them typing in a lower reading. 15 points each, 25 for one that lowers the meter, up to 50.
reasons.READING_JUMPS: {{count}} shifts opened on a different reading than the previous shift closed on, with no amendment or meter rollover to explain it. 20 points each, up to 40.
reasons.SALES_OUTLIERS: {{count}} of {{shifts}} shifts sold under half or over double the nozzle's usual litres for that shift. 10 points each, up to 30.
reasons.LOSS_WEEKS: Lost more than {{limitPercent}}% of sales in {{lossWeeks}} of {{weeks}} weeks. Up to 40 points for the share of loss weeks.
reasons.LOSS_STREAK: Longest run of loss weeks in a row: {{weeks}}. 10 points for each week after the first, up to 30.
reasons.PERIOD_LOSS: Variance over the whole period: {{percent}}% of sales, against a {{limitPercent}}% loss limit. 30 points for a loss above the limit, 15 above half of it.
reasons.PERIOD_LOSS_NO_SALES: No sales to compare over the whole period, so no points against the {{limitPercent}}% loss limit.
reasons.NOT_ENOUGH_WEEKS: Only {{weeks}} weeks with reconciled dips; tanks are scored from {{minimum}} weeks.

howItWorks.title: How the scores work
howItWorks.summary: Each person, nozzle and tank gets 0–100 points from a few simple rules. Open "Why this score" on a card to see every rule, its points and the events behind it.
howItWorks.bands: Low is under 30, Watch is 30 to 59, High is 60 and above.
howItWorks.people: People: up to 60 points for shortages on their own shifts compared with everyone else, and up to 40 for voids, reassignments and rejections. Shortages of ₹20 or less are ignored. Owners are not scored.
howItWorks.nozzles: Nozzles: meter amendments, readings that jump between shifts, and shifts far from the nozzle's usual sales.
howItWorks.tanks: Tanks: weeks that lost more than the tank's loss limit, losses several weeks in a row, and the loss over the whole period.
howItWorks.notEnoughData: With fewer than {{minimum}} closed shifts, or fewer than 3 weeks of dips for a tank, a card says "Not enough data yet".
howItWorks.innocentReasons: Scores show where to look first. There is often an everyday reason: a new staff member, a meter repair, a festival rush.
howItWorks.weekly: Owners and admins get a summary every Monday when something scores Watch or High.
